data_source: Yahoo Finance unofficial adjusted close proxies
limitations: Exploratory variant selected after observing original losses, hence vulnerable to overfitting. After a 10% drawdown, new entries pause for 30 common trading sessions and the risk peak resets at reactivation. Retrospective research, not an untouched independent test. Every selection uses prior completed calendar years only, but synthetic execution at the same daily close after seeing it is not executable in reality. Historical adjusted prices differ from raw tradeable fills. Cash held in USD, no FX, tax, cash interest or real dividend handling. Missing cross-ETF trading dates are excluded; intraday stop losses, order spreads and gaps are not modeled. Benchmark QQQ is a hypothetical cost-free buy and hold. Open positions are marked to market at final date; no forced liquidation.
